mapper.sql: SELECT o.id,o.order_no,o.customer_id,c.customer_name,o.agent_id,a.agent_name,i.product_model_id model_id,m.model_name,i.ordered_qty order_qty,i.shipped_qty,o.status,o.planned_ship_date,o.created_at,o.updated_at FROM bike_sales_order o JOIN bike_customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id LEFT JOIN bike_agent a ON a.id=o.agent_id JOIN bike_sales_order_item i ON i.order_id=o.id JOIN bike_product_model m ON m.id=i.product_model_id

where.if: AND (o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR c.customer_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_sales_order o JOIN bike_customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id

SELECT v.id vehicle_id, v.frame_sn, so.stock_out_no, so.operation_time stock_out_time FROM bike_sales_order_vehicle ov JOIN bike_vehicle v ON v.id=ov.vehicle_id JOIN bike_stock_out_record so ON so.id=ov.stock_out_record_id AND so.status='COMPLETED' WHERE ov.order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY so.operation_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_customer WHERE id=#{customerId} AND status='ENABLED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_product_model WHERE id=#{modelId} AND enabled=1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_agent WHERE id=#{agentId} AND status='ENABLED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bike_sales_order_item(order_id,product_model_id,ordered_qty,shipped_qty) SELECT id,#{request.modelId},#{request.orderQty},0 FROM bike_sales_order WHERE order_no=#{orderNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE bike_sales_order SET customer_id=#{request.customerId},agent_id=#{request.agentId},planned_ship_date=#{request.plannedShipDate} WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('DRAFT','PENDING')
UPDATE bike_sales_order_item SET product_model_id=#{request.modelId},ordered_qty=#{request.orderQty} WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND shipped_qty <= #{request.orderQty}
UPDATE bike_sales_order SET status=#{status} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE bike_sales_order_item SET shipped_qty=shipped_qty+#{qty} WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND shipped_qty+#{qty} <= ordered_qty
